name: stack_pays_window_and_stake
description: A stacked horn pays each seat the whole window it skips and the stake (contract-m8 §2, design 2.7): window_t for the hollow's seats in whole seconds (10 solo, 15 with company) plus stake_pm per mille of the lives the waves on the road could still take, rounded down: the tolls of their creeps walking the road and of those the Welling has still to send, so a call made while the older wave is still setting out stakes all of it. One EV_GOLD 'stack'; EV_WAVE's stacked horn says the stake (those lives) and each seat's pay. SimMatch.stack_pay and road_tolls say the same before the horn, and [0, 0] outside a wave. Solo: wave 2 called on tick 30 of wave 1, one Gourdling walking and nine to come (a stake of 10); wave 3 called on tick 60 with wave 1's ten and wave 2's eighteen on the road or to come (28), three waves on the road at once. Then two present seats, where one seat's Ready waits for the other's and both are paid. No towers, so every creep stays on the road.

steps.msg: in a window a stacked horn pays nothing
one Gourdling walks and nine are still to come: the stake is all ten
the horn would pay the 10 s window and 400 per mille of the ten lives
one EV_GOLD 'stack': the window and the stake together, on the horn's tick
the stacked horn names its stake, the lives, and each seat's pay

steps.assert: scene.client(1).can_stack(0) and third[2] == 28 and third[1] == 28 and third[0] == [10, 11]
steps.msg: with wave 1's ten and wave 2's eighteen on the road or to come, a call for wave 3 would pay 10 + 11
wave 3 called: three waves on the road, the call paid 21

steps.assert: scene.rows('WAVE', ['wave'], {'start': true}) == [[1]] and scene.client(1).seat(1).ready and not scene.client(1).seat(2).ready
steps.msg: with company the horn waits for every present seat

steps.assert: two[3] == 10 and two[4] == 0 and two[0] == [rules['window_t'][1] / 60, rules['stake_pm'] * 10 / 1000] and two[0][0] == 15
steps.msg: wave 1 all walking: with company the window skipped is 15 s, the stake its ten lives
the second seat's Ready sounds the stacked horn on the tick it lands, and each seat is paid in full

steps.assert: scene.gold(1) == two[1] + two[0][0] + two[0][1] and scene.gold(2) == two[2] + two[0][0] + two[0][1] and scene.client(1).waves_on_road(0) == PackedInt32Array([1, 2])
steps.msg: both seats' gold, and both waves on the road
